title: Abraham's Two Sons and the Two Covenants
description: Paul uses the story of Abraham's two sons as a symbolic picture of two covenants: one that bears children into slavery (Hagar, Mount Sinai, and the present Jerusalem) and one that gives freedom (the free woman and the heavenly Jerusalem). He urges believers to see themselves as children of the promise, like Isaac, and not as children of the slave woman. [ref:Gal 4:22-31|Galatians 4:22-31]
